SL.PASSAnchors: Only original five SL values passing U02 individual gate; Stage1 3/5 requirement unchanged

LocalScan.EndpointRule: Deterministically round range endpoints to 5-pip units; preserve anchor; follow the normative examples
LocalScan.SmallAnchorException: Only when fewer than three 5-pip points exist in the anchor ±20% range, mechanically extend to Anchor-5/Anchor/Anchor+5

PASSZone.Retention: Zone Median AvgPips >= Pure Time AvgPips * 0.80

SL.Selection: Lower median SL of winning zone; may differ from original five anchors

TP.Prerequisite: Formal SL frozen; never change SL from TP results
TP.LocalEligibility: Passing finite anchor must have at least one adjacent coarse finite anchor also passing; TP_NONE is not a neighbor

LocalScan.EndpointRule: Deterministically round range endpoints to 5-pip units; preserve anchor; follow the normative examples

TP.FiniteCandidate: Lower median TP of winning zone

AdoptionAllRequired.MedianAnnualAvgPipsImprovement: finite - TP_NONE >= max(0.10 pips/trade, TP_NONE MedianAnnualAvgPips * 0.05)

TP.Fallback: TP_NONE if no qualified finite candidate or adoption conditions not met

FrozenU06.AfterFreeze: Never return to SL/TP from Weekday/DOM/Month/1m/Event/MFE results

EndpointSupplement.Rounding: Nearest 5 pips HALF_UP independently for each endpoint; Decimal, never builtin round
EndpointSupplement.Grid: Lower through Upper inclusive, step5; anchor included
EndpointSupplement.Source: Explicit user supplemental decision after endpoint ambiguity STOP

EnvironmentPolicy: Normal resume exact Python/NumPy/pandas; NumPy2.3.5/pandas2.2.3 required
DriveMirroring: Synchronous verified staging; marker last; before next candidate
